label: Florida: excluded data
note: Verified editorial summary, not a verbatim statutory extract. Primary text retrieved for the September 22, 2026 applicability candidate.
body: Section 501.704 exempts specified protected-health, health-research, patient-safety, regulated credit, DPPA, FERPA, Farm Credit, employment-role and other listed data subject to their statutory conditions. An exemption for some data does not extend to unrelated data or every activity of the holder.
